delivered_scope: Phase 09 canonical manifest and active candidate based on main SHA 12b519c3e8237e1ebe43c1a0253b0747e0680e07.
Coolify-oriented homologation Compose with web, worker-default, worker-integrations, Beat, release and Redis in one stack.
PostgreSQL removed from the homologation application stack and represented only by the required external DATABASE_URL contract.
No public Redis or Celery ports; only web exposes container port 8000 for Coolify proxy ingress.
Production settings used in homologation with external effects fail-closed by default.
Environment-variable contract with placeholders only; no real credentials.
Operational runbook for Coolify topology, migrations, health, backup/restore, rollback, observability, incident response and provider subgates.

Incident response procedure covers severity classification, containment, evidence preservation, recovery/rollback decision, controlled recovery, post-incident validation, escalation and governance impact.
Foundation CI renders and validates docker-compose.homologation.yml in addition to local/test Compose definitions.
Governance orchestrator fixture updated for the active Phase 09 candidate.

independent_review.finding: docs/HOMOLOGATION.md previously lacked an operational incident response procedure covering classification, containment, evidence preservation, rollback/recovery decision, post-incident validation and escalation.
independent_review.resolution: The rework adds the complete operational incident response procedure to docs/HOMOLOGATION.md and changes no runtime or domain code. Comparison from the prior documentary carrier 86f74800f2c799214770226d09731748c7821b01 to fac5e9c0d86b2137c8542d7ef4101e1746a38fab is one commit changing only docs/HOMOLOGATION.md.

qa_security.evidence: Independent QA/Security issued technical GO on material SHA fac5e9c0d86b2137c8542d7ef4101e1746a38fab. Foundation CI #209 / run 31849693025 passed with 454 tests, 0 skipped, 86% coverage and PostgreSQL 17.11. P09-IR-001 remains resolved. Real restore proof, private PostgreSQL networking and actual Coolify runtime behavior remain explicitly environment-dependent and are not claimed as proven.

deferred: real Coolify resource provisioning and runtime acceptance evidence until separately authorized
provider sandbox activation and credentials until provider-specific authorization
risks: The external PostgreSQL resource must be reachable privately from the Coolify application stack without exposing port 5432 publicly.
Backup/restore must be proven in the real homologation environment before production/cutover authorization.
Production SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT requires internal healthchecks to represent the proxy HTTPS scheme; the homologation Compose supplies X-Forwarded-Proto=https.
Redis is intentionally ephemeral for the initial homologation stack; durable canonical state remains in PostgreSQL.
Real incident-response execution can only be evidenced after an authorized homologation environment exists; the required operational procedure is documented.
GitHub Actions still emits the known non-blocking Node.js 20 deprecation warning while actions are forced onto Node.js 24.

human_approval.evidence: Human explicitly approved Phase 09 after Independent Review READY_FOR_QA_AND_SECURITY and QA/Security GO, and explicitly authorized governance closeout plus PR/merge. Product PR #21 was merged to main. The approval does not authorize real Coolify deployment, provider activation, production, go-live or Phase 10.
